sources.revision: GitHub release tag v0.16.3 points to abbreviated commit d5e4336. PyPI 0.16.3 artifact metadata was inspected on 2026-10-20; the MIT sdist SHA-256 is 77978afa63fdcc61a18abbd581b9bb1cdac09e5a1747840bb689fbd9771b230c and the macOS universal2 wheel SHA-256 is 50414743576011389c2382c7a129da78cdd0b3bf17af05f3beef88597b7ff0c8. No artifact was downloaded or run. Mutable main still declares workspace 0.16.3 while its internal Cargo.lock entries are 0.16.0; older plan evidence recorded 0.12.12.
sources.observed: README declares DWG reading AC1012-AC1032 and lists a narrower high-level set of LINE, ARC, LWPOLYLINE, POINT, CIRCLE, ELLIPSE, TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, INSERT/MINSERT, HATCH, and SPLINE. It documents AC1012/AC1014 as experimental, modern native decoders for a narrower common-entity set, best-effort color resolution for some later files, an AC1015-only native DWG writer, and ezdxf as the DXF writing backend. The high-level API distinguishes modelspace, paperspace, all entities, and placement. Core Cargo.toml depends on encoding_rs; the inspected mutable Cargo.lock has no LibreDWG/ACadSharp codec dependency. PyPI metadata separately pins a binary artifact, but does not prove that its bytes correspond to the Git tag or establish complete parser ancestry. PyPI reports upload without Trusted Publishing.
sources.limits: A hash-pinned wheel permits reproducible binary behavior observations, but not a source-lineage claim; source archive/tag correspondence and parser ancestry remain unverified. The dependency graph is not a source-provenance audit. No parser tests, package, or executable was run. No documented ACIS/3DSOLID/REGION/BODY semantic route was identified.
